tier_legend.1: combat behaviour through hooks and Cmd facades that exist in the sim (var overloads of ported methods count as existing); power content from the power wave is a dependency, not a tier raise
tier_legend.2: needs hooks, Cmd facades or card/combat-state APIs that exist in the game but not in the sim (AfterCombatEnd/Victory, combat-room AfterRoomEntered, CardCmd.Upgrade, room type, gold in combat, ...)
tier_legend.3: needs a player prompt or a new subsystem: orbs, Osty/pets, stars, forge, card generation, combat history, potion slots, extra turns, enchantments, or any run-layer behaviour (run layer = new subsystem)
tier_legend.4: decompile loss or cross-cutting behaviour spanning several subsystems

prompt_type_legend.PileSelect: CardSelectCmd.FromCombatPile (draw pile sorted by rarity then id, discard pile in order)
prompt_type_legend.ChooseCard: CardSelectCmd.FromChooseACardScreen (1 of n generated cards, optional skip)
prompt_type_legend.RestSiteOption: adds an option to the rest-site menu (TryModifyRestSiteOptions)
prompt_type_legend.CardRewardAlternative: adds an alternative to every card reward (TryModifyCardRewardAlternatives)

port_batch_legend.1: OnUse through ported facades and ported powers
port_batch_legend.2: OnUse needs power content from the power wave
port_batch_legend.3: OnUse needs missing facades/card APIs (in-combat upgrade, pile moves, Shiv/Soul creation, cost randomization, replay count)
port_batch_legend.4: subsystems: orbs, Osty, stars, forge, doom, auto-play, potion procurement, automatic use, card generation without prompt
